title: What a medicine show was; Dr. Moon's company
summary: Joe explains medicine shows as a way to draw customers with live music and introduces Dr. Moon's company, based in Baton Rouge.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Let me ask you this. When you got through with this Martel band, where did you go then? Who did you play with after them?
Well, that's where the medicine show starts.
Yeah, I was going to get somewhere into that medicine show business. What exactly is a medicine show? What did they do?

A medicine show is just a high class... It's a way to hustle up customers, people, to get them interested in whatever medicine you're selling. Well, that goes for almost anything you're selling. But medicine shows was one of the few ways that people in even those small towns could hear some live music.

Not always. The band that I left Opelousas with, Dr. Moon Medicine Company it was called, was owned by a millionaire -- and his name was Doctor Moon. I don't know I think they called him Frank or whatever. But I never called him anything...nobody called him anything but Dr. Moon.
